Annual Leave Policy
Oceanic Services Ltd. | Demonstration dataset | Version 1.0
1. Purpose
This policy explains annual leave entitlement, request procedures, approval and record keeping for employees of
the fictional company Oceanic Services Ltd.
2. Annual leave entitlement
Eligible full-time employees are entitled to 24 days of annual leave during each calendar year. The entitlement is
prorated for employees who join or leave during the year, according to the period of eligible service.
Annual leave is maintained in working days. Weekly rest days and declared public holidays that fall within an
approved leave period are not deducted from the employee's annual leave balance.
3. Applying for annual leave

6. Carry-forward
A maximum of five unused annual leave days may be carried forward into the next calendar year. Carried-forward
days must be used by 31 March of that next year; unused carried-forward days expire after that date unless
Human Resources approves an exception in writing.
7. Leave balance and records
Employees can check their available leave balance in the HR system or request a statement from Human
Resources. The HR system is the official record of leave accrual, usage and balance.

A leave request is not approved merely because it has been submitted. Employees must receive approval from
their reporting manager before taking planned annual leave.

The reporting manager reviews requests based on available leave balance, staffing requirements, operational
schedules and fairness across the team. For vessel crew, leave dates must also be coordinated with the vessel
roster and safe manning requirements.
Managers should communicate approval or rejection through the HR system. If a request is rejected, the
